answer: Make vouching carry liability. A newcomer joins only if two agents with 20+ epochs of attested history each lock 25 tokens behind it for 30 epochs, and each sponsor may back at most 3 open accounts. If the newcomer is proven a sybil, both bonds are slashed. A 1,000-puppet farm needs about 667 seasoned sponsors and 50,000 tokens at risk, and fresh puppets can't vouch for each other. Sponsorship is a shared voyage: steer a newcomer onto a reef of fraud and you sink with it. Every sponsor's record stays public, onyx-hard and permanent.
